acceptanceCriteria: Before/after shard logs show the build/link gap falling from a median of about 85s.
A PR-scoped cache entry is never restored on a push run (cache API listing).
A testconfine run passes with no new read-scope entries.
body: Found 2026-10-10 by the CI audit (report /private/tmp/claude-501/gotmp/ci-audit.md; 60 ci.yml runs; main run 38055182050). PR wall median 39.8 min, critical path always go-product-shard 0. Shard build/link gaps median ~85s; docs-plan builds cmd/corvint cold on the critical path. Main pushes save a Go build cache, PRs restore only; -count=1 stays so no test results are cached. Full-run path only: qualification and pinned narrowed rows stay cold (AFP-V0-014/015), artifact-integrity stays cold. Check testconfine needs no new read-scope entries for GOCACHE.
title: ci: trusted Go build-cache profile (main-written, restore-only on PRs, never test results)
